{{Quote|I was twelve. His name was Palo. We were both in the Legislative Youth Program.|Padmé Amidala, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The '''Legislative Youth Program''' was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide organization devoted to the education of youths from across the [[Star/Legends|stars]] interested in entering public service. Some [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], had mandatory service laws which required all citizens to serve in the Program for a certain number of years. The organization therefore oversaw Naboo's mandatory public service curricula, holding their headquarters on the planet in [[Theed University/Legends|Theed University]].

==History==
Founded sometime during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] reign, the Legislative Youth Program spread across the Republic to include countless worlds. On [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], particpation in the Program was mandatory<ref name="SWDP" /> from ages twelve to twenty,<ref name="NC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> although [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Naberrie]] joined the Program at age eight. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was participating in the Program when he met [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]]. The members of the Program met annually for a month-long retreat on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], in and around the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]]. There, the young delegates entered into mock [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] trials in order for the participants to gain first-hand experience working with galactic issues.<ref name="SWDP" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], one such trial was held in which the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] was voted on. It passed by a margin of 52% to 48%.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_6.html|Legislative Youth Program Role-Plays Vote}}</ref> During the retreat, the members also used to tour Chandrila's vast agricultural projects, wilderness areas, coral reefs, and [[Garden/Legends|garden]] parks (including [[Gladean State Parks|Gladean Park]]).<ref name="SWDP" />

==Behind the scenes==
As described in [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], the Legislative Youth Program resembles [[Wikipedia:Model United Nations|Model United Nations]].
